genre.zh: 旅遊雜誌（Condé Nast Traveler）的飯店專題
genre.en: a Condé Nast Traveler hotel feature: real rooms and halls in natural light, a guest's moment, calm luxury

s: a king bed made up in crisp unironed linen fills the frame, set against a deep-sea-blue accent wall in a real guest room, a hard shaft of late-afternoon window light raking across the sheets and throwing the curtain's sharp shadow over the headboard

the hotel's own bathroom seen from the doorway, a freestanding tub huge in frame against terracotta-orange wall tile, one hard beam from a high window casting a crisp diagonal shadow across the floor and rim

a long breakfast-buffet counter in the real ground-floor restaurant, foreground dishes large, a muted tomato-red back wall behind, hard morning sun from the left laying long shadows of the serving tongs across the white platters

an empty banquet hall shot from a low chair-level angle, one round table dressed in linen filling the foreground against a deep-teal wall, a single hard spotlight from the ceiling dropping a sharp ring of shadow around the table

a king bed shot from its foot, the rumpled linen filling most of the frame, against a deep-sea-blue wall in the actual guest room, hard low sun from the window on the right throwing the sheer curtain's striped shadow across the duvet

a pair of slippers and the bed's edge seen from floor level, the bed huge in frame, muted mint-green wall behind, hard morning light from a side window casting a long crisp shadow of the bedside lamp across the carpet
the plump pillows stacked at the headboard in a tight close crop, a clay-orange headboard wall behind them, a hard beam from the bedside window carving a sharp diagonal shadow across the cotton

a traveler's open suitcase at the foot of the king bed in the real room, the bed dominating the frame, tomato-red accent wall, hard late-afternoon sun striking from the left with long shadows over the floor and bedspread

two beds side by side made up with rumpled sheets and a child's backpack tossed at the end of one, the beds filling the frame against a sage-green wall in the real family room, hard midday sun through the window laying a long window-frame shadow over both duvets

the family room's bathroom counter in close crop with the DAMANA and tea-seed amenity bottles large in the foreground, terracotta wall tile behind, one hard overhead beam casting crisp bottle shadows across the basin

a breakfast tray with four place settings of cooked eggs, toast and fruit on the room's window table, table large in frame, deep-navy curtain behind, hard morning sun from the side throwing sharp shadows of the cups across the cloth

a view from the bed pillow of two kids' feet sticking out of the blanket in the family room, the bed large in frame, mustard-yellow wall behind, a hard stripe of afternoon sun falling across the blanket

a deep soaking bathtub filling the frame in the real executive-floor bathroom, a muted ocean-teal tile wall behind, one hard shaft of window light drawing a sharp diagonal shadow across the tub rim and floor

the in-room tea set and a plate of cookies and chocolate on the writing desk, the tray large in frame, a clay-orange wall behind, hard side light from the window casting long crisp shadows of the cups across the wood

a glass-walled shower stall seen head-on, wet tiles and chrome fixtures filling the frame, a deep-blue wall beside it, hard overhead light throwing a crisp rain of shadows from the shower head onto the floor

the king bed with a folded robe and fruit bowl on the bedspread, bed dominating the frame against a tomato-red accent wall, hard low sun from the window raking across the linen and throwing the bowl's shadow long

a nespresso-style capsule coffee machine on the suite's living-room sideboard, machine large in frame, a deep-sea-blue wall behind, hard morning sun from the window casting a sharp cup shadow across the wood top

the suite's doorway between the living room and the bedroom, the open bed visible beyond, a muted terracotta wall framing the opening, a hard blade of window light dropping a sharp rectangle on the floor

a bride's dress hung on the wardrobe door in the suite's living room, the gown large in frame, a mint-green wall behind it, hard window light from the left throwing the dress's sharp shadow across the wall
the suite's second bathroom, a double vanity and mirror filling the frame against a dark-teal tile wall, one hard beam from a high window casting crisp shadows of the faucets across the stone
the long ceiling of the banquet hall seen from a low seat, round tables in rows below, hard spotlights dropping sharp circles of light on the white linens, the deep-teal walls framing the scene

the 275-inch seamless screen filling the frame at the front of the real hall, a deep-navy-blue wall surrounding it, a single hard spotlight from the side throwing the empty stage's long shadow across the carpet

one round table in the foreground of the hall with a plated course of the chef's banquet dishes, table large in frame, a rich-burgundy wall behind, hard overhead beam casting crisp shadows of the glasses across the cloth

the hall's wide double doors seen from inside with the high ceiling above, doors large in frame against a clay-orange wall, hard light from the lobby streaming through and laying long door-frame shadows across the carpet

the rounded ceiling of the banquet hall filling the frame, coloured wall lights glowing against a mustard-yellow curve, one hard spotlight from above throwing a crisp ring of shadow across a nearby table
a round table set for a wedding in the real hall, the table large in frame against a deep-plum wall, a hard beam from the left throwing long crisp shadows of the chairs across the carpet
the head table and its chairs, viewed from the aisle, filling the frame against a dusty-rose wall, a hard stage spot from the right laying sharp shadows across the floor
a close view of the hall's arched wall and ceiling edge, deep-teal paint, hard light from a ceiling spot casting a sharp curved shadow across the surface
a small round table in the dark-toned hall, table large in frame against a charcoal-navy wall, one hard recessed ceiling light dropping a crisp circle of shadow beneath the glasses and plates
the curved ceiling of the smaller hall, warm-orange wall washed in low light, one hard beam from the side laying a sharp curved shadow across the plaster
a plated course on a banquet table in the real hall, the dish large in frame against a deep-wine wall, hard side light from a ceiling spot throwing sharp shadows of the fork across the linen
an empty row of chairs at a banquet table in the hall, the chairs filling the frame against a terracotta wall, hard late light from a doorway casting long crisp chair shadows across the carpet
a family banquet table seen from a low seat, the lazy Susan and plates large in frame against a clay-orange wall, hard side light from the window throwing sharp shadows of the dishes across the cloth
the private room's door half-open in the hallway, the room large in frame against a deep-green wall, a hard blade of light from inside throwing a long sharp rectangle across the carpet
a round table for six in a private dining room, table filling the frame against a muted mustard wall, hard overhead spot throwing crisp shadows of the teacups across the linen
a pair of hands passing a platter across the table in the real private room, platter large in frame, a deep-teal wall behind, hard window light from the left casting sharp shadows across the cloth
a bride's dress hung on the suite's wardrobe door, gown large in frame against a mint-green wall, hard window light from the left throwing the dress's sharp shadow across the wall

the suite's vanity mirror and makeup brushes laid out, the vanity filling the frame against a dusty-rose wall, hard window light striking from the right with crisp shadows of the brushes across the counter

the suite's living-room sofa with family members' shoes and bags set down, sofa large in frame against a terracotta wall, hard afternoon sun from the window throwing long crisp shadows across the carpet

a breakfast table the morning after in the hotel restaurant, plates and cups large in frame, a deep-blue wall behind, hard morning light from the window throwing sharp shadows of the cups across the cloth

a whole roast Peking duck being carved at the table in the real Chinese restaurant, the duck large in frame against a deep-red wall, hard overhead light throwing a crisp shadow of the knife across the board
a Boston lobster dish on a lazy Susan in the real private room, the plate large in frame against a deep-teal wall, hard side light throwing sharp shadows of the claws across the cloth
the round table with hands reaching across for the dishes, platters large in frame, a clay-orange wall behind, hard window light from the left casting long crisp shadows of chopsticks over the linen
a stack of duck pancakes and sauces on the restaurant table, plates large in frame, a mustard-yellow wall behind, hard late sun from the window throwing sharp shadows across the cloth
a chef flipping a steak on the iron griddle at the real counter, the griddle large in frame against a deep-red wall, one hard overhead light throwing the spatula's crisp shadow across the steel
a plated teppanyaki course in front of a couple at the counter, the plate large in frame, a dark-teal wall behind, hard overhead light throwing sharp shadows of the chopsticks across the counter
a close view of the griddle with seared vegetables and steam, griddle large in frame against a clay-orange wall, hard side light throwing sharp shadows of the spatula across the steel
two people seated at the counter watching the chef from behind, counter large in frame, a muted navy wall, hard overhead spotlight dropping crisp shadows of the wine glasses across the counter

a long buffet counter in the real ground-floor café, foreground dishes large, a tomato-red wall behind, hard morning sun from the window throwing long sharp shadows of the serving tongs across the platters

a family's plates heaped with hot and cold dishes on a café table, plates large in frame against a mint-green wall, hard window light from the left throwing sharp shadows of the forks across the cloth
the dessert section of the real buffet, cakes in rows filling the frame against a deep-teal wall, hard overhead light casting crisp shadows of the cake stands across the counter
a birthday dessert plate carried to a café table, plate large in frame against a mustard wall, hard side sun from the window throwing a long crisp shadow of the plate across the tablecloth

the king bed turned down for the night with rumpled sheets, bed large in frame against a deep-wine wall in the real room, a hard beam from the bedside lamp throwing a sharp lampshade shadow across the headboard
a pair of wedding shoes at the foot of the bed in the real room, the bed huge behind them, deep-navy wall, hard low light from the window throwing long sharp shoe shadows across the carpet
the bathtub filled and steaming in the real bathroom, the tub large in frame against a dark-teal tile wall, one hard shaft of window light throwing a crisp diagonal shadow across the rim

a wedding suit and dress hung side by side on the wardrobe in the room, garments large in frame against a terracotta wall, hard window light from the left throwing sharp garment shadows across the wall

a traveler's open suitcase on the king bed in the real room, the bed filling the frame against a deep-sea-blue wall, hard afternoon sun from the window throwing the curtain's sharp shadow across the sheets

a breakfast plate of Taiwanese dishes on the real restaurant table, the plate large in frame against a tomato-red wall, hard morning sun from the left throwing sharp shadows of the chopsticks across the cloth
the room window with the Taichung city view and the desk beside it, desk large in frame against a mint-green wall, hard sun from outside throwing a crisp window-frame shadow across the desk
a pair of walking shoes by the room door with a city map on the bed, bed large in frame against a clay-orange wall, hard low sun from the window throwing long sharp shadows across the carpet
